verdict.rationale: Lovable's editor documents a live preview pane where you watch your app take shape while chatting. Collaborators each get their own draft with its own preview, and publishing is a separate later step that deploys a snapshot, so the preview clearly comes before publishing. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the preview is fully interactive (clicking through flows, testing auth or data), independent hands-on corroboration of preview interactivity.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing

citations.quote: you describe what you want in the chat panel on the left, and you watch your app take shape in the preview on the right
each of you can work in your own draft: a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview
Publishing turns your Lovable project into a live web app by deploying a snapshot to a URL you can share.
